name: The Long Carry
pitch: Let the blows land on your body and keep your breath: whoever has more linh lực left hits half as hard again, and the whole sect is taught to be that person by the second second.

new.name: Longer Breath
new.effect: +50 points to hits while your linh lực share is more than 10 points above the enemy's. Two grades: a lead of 10 here, a lead of 0 in The Deepest Well; one lead would change fights.
new.second_home: any ward-breaker or drainer; used by The Deepest Well

new.name: Thrift
new.effect: A quarter of your ward efficiency also counts as art_cost_pct, inside its 50 % limit.
new.second_home: any per-hit ward build, any cheap art build; used by The Deepest Well

new.name: First Load Method
new.effect: Body, Hoàng giai, 6 layers, no element. Volume I of the ladder: Even Step, Shifted Pole, Longer Breath, Sustained Note.

new.name: Two Baskets Method
new.effect: Body, Huyền giai, 9 layers, no element. Volume II: Home Road, Thrift, Setting Down, Over the Ridge; re-lists Volume I's arts at layer 7.

new.name: Long Slope Scripture
new.effect: Body, Địa giai, 12 layers, no element. Volume III: Second Wind; handover at layer 10. Not run.

new.name: Ten Thousand Steps Scripture
new.effect: Body, Thiên giai, 15 layers, no element. Volume IV: Hill Road; handover at layer 13. Not run.

new.name: Home Road
new.effect: The escape art, cost 0.06, 1 s, guarded on own health below 50 %.

questions: Should raising a drain ward's strength be able to lose a fight on its own? Moving 48 points from we to ws turns a win into a loss with the enemy on 53 %.
Do two body techniques add their t_b? The two-basket ladder assumes they do.
Should the ladder's last layer teach instead of fight? That would be this build's one rule ask, so it is left out.
